query: Where was the coach of the 1999 Oklahoma State Cowboys football team hired in 2013?

pipeline_result.response: The coach of the 1999 Oklahoma State Cowboys football team was Mike Gundy from 2013 to 2014. He coached the team for a total of three years, starting with his thirteenth year as head coach in 2013 and ending with his twelfth year as head coach in 2015.

2013 Oklahoma State Cowboys football team: The 2013 Oklahoma State Cowboys football team represented Oklahoma State University in the 2013 NCAA Division I FBS football season.
